cn2.text: Mitul, Rashmi's assistant, notes traces of transmuted matter in a failed transporter test, and they plan a more stable aether stream as they face qualifiers within a week, hoping for the Consulate's support.

On the afternoon of the qualifiers the 887th flower implodes and the filament snaps, and Mitul admits they have no spare filament, and every shop in Ghirapur is out of it, so Rashmi tells him they must close the inquirium.
Saheeli returns to the inquirium and Mitul slams the door in her face, but the transporter successfully moves the vase across the room, and Rashmi and Mitul present it to Padeem.
